title: Plans in beads
description:
The plan itself, stored as a bead.

## Shape

One epic per plan, one child task per step.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  idea --> plan
  plan --> steps
  steps --> done
```

## Reading

The detail page renders every field.
design:
## Fields

idea becomes description, plan becomes design, criteria become acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: The list, the labels page and the detail page all read from bd.
notes: The Notes field is rendered as its own section.
